{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Strip commas from revenue and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Exclude internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
mask_test = df['revenue'] != 999999.99

# Exclude refunded orders (only completed orders)
mask_completed = df['status'] == 'completed'

# Apply both filters
df_filtered = df[mask_test & mask_completed]

# Compute total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = df_filtered['revenue'].sum()

total_revenue"}
